scope: Synthetic typed-fact semantic matching and deterministic capability compilation. Cases isolate matching from LLM extraction and PDF/OCR. All methods and procedures are fictional metadata.
candidate_scope: Each requirement may select only its own case candidate_test_ids and capability IDs. Batching must not expose another case capability as an authorized candidate.
limitations: Author-designed development cases are not independently validated or a blinded statistical holdout.
Expected outcomes describe intended safe task behavior, including known coverage gaps; they must not be changed after observing model responses.
Typed reference facts and the deliberately incomplete category case do not measure extraction accuracy.
Alternative complete outcomes are predeclared only when more than one conservative alignment is valid; always score against an entire outcome, not favorable fields picked from different alternatives.
Positive free-context and material synonym cases require explicit semantic evidence; unsafe literal equivalence must not be inferred for other cases.
